text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Philippine Vice-President Joseph Estrada says new measures underway to ensure welfare of overseas Filipino workers.
- Bahrain's Ramsis Contracting and Maintenance Services Co launches $2 million joint venture with South Africa's Elgin Engineering.
- Foreign ministry says Qatar has endangered Bahrain's national security.
- Bahrain's state security court sentences one person to three years in jail for joining illegal group.
- Gulf Arab summit starts in Qatar with Bahrain boycotting the gathering.
- Bahrain television broadcasts interview with father of Qatari man accused by Manama of spying for Qatar.
